unit_proposal.title: Build and dispatch safe command requests
unit_proposal.summary: Compose bounded argument lists, select known transformations and prepare results before publication.

wrong.name: ignores_unique
wrong.source:
invalid() { printf 'Usage: manifest asc|desc all|unique SOURCE\n' >&2; }
if test "$#" -ne 3; then invalid; exit 2; fi
order=$1
policy=$2
source=$3
case "$order" in asc|desc) : ;; *) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$policy" in all|unique) : ;; *) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$source" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
if test -f "$source"; then :; else printf 'Missing source: %s\n' "$source" >&2; exit 1; fi
LC_ALL=C
command=(sort)
if test "$order" = desc; then command=("${command[@]}" -r); fi
command=("${command[@]}" -- "$source")
"${command[@]}"
wrong.misconception: Keeping repeats is correct for all but breaks independent unique requests.

alternates:
transform() {
 case "$1" in ordered|neighbors|owners) : ;; *) printf 'Rejected job %s: unknown operation\n' "$number" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
 case "$2" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) printf 'Rejected job %s: invalid source\n' "$number" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
 if test -f "$2"; then :; else printf 'Missing source for job %s: %s\n' "$number" "$2" >&2; return 1; fi
 printf 'Job %s: %s\n' "$number" "$1"
 case "$1" in
  ordered) sort -- "$2" ;;
  neighbors) uniq -- "$2" ;;
  owners) cut -s -d ':' -f 3 -- "$2" ;;
 esac
}
count=$#
if test "$count" -eq 0 || test "$((count % 2))" -ne 0; then printf 'Usage: transform OP SOURCE ...\n' >&2; exit 2; fi

failed=0

 number=$((number + 1))
 if transform "$1" "$2"; then :; else failed=1; fi
 shift 2
done

wrong.name: global_unique_for_neighbors
wrong.source:
count=$#
if test "$count" -eq 0 || test "$((count % 2))" -ne 0; then
 printf 'Usage: transform OP SOURCE ...\n' >&2; exit 2
fi
LC_ALL=C
number=0
failed=0
while test "$#" -gt 0; do
 number=$((number + 1))
 action=$1
 file=$2
 shift 2
 ready=yes
 command=()
 case "$action" in
  ordered) command=(sort) ;;
  neighbors) command=(sort -u) ;;
  owners) command=(cut -s -d ':' -f 3) ;;
  *) printf 'Rejected job %s: unknown operation\n' "$number" >&2; ready=no; failed=1 ;;
 esac
 if test "$ready" = yes; then
  case "$file" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) printf 'Rejected job %s: invalid source\n' "$number" >&2; ready=no; failed=1 ;; esac
 fi
 if test "$ready" = yes; then
  if test -f "$file"; then :; else
   printf 'Missing source for job %s: %s\n' "$number" "$file" >&2; ready=no; failed=1
  fi
 fi
 if test "$ready" = yes; then
  command=("${command[@]}" -- "$file")
  printf 'Job %s: %s\n' "$number" "$action"
  "${command[@]}"
 fi
done
exit "$failed"
wrong.misconception: Sorting before deduplication changes order and removes separated duplicates that neighbors must retain.

guard_cases.name: Reject a directory component per job

alternates:
invalid() { printf 'Invalid transformation plan\n' >&2; }
if test "$#" -lt 4; then invalid; exit 2; fi
mode=$1
destination=$2
shift 2
count=$#
if test "$((count % 2))" -ne 0; then invalid; exit 2; fi
case "$mode" in preview|apply) : ;; *) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$destination" in ''|-|.|..|*/*|keep.txt) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
LC_ALL=C
prepare() {
 local number=0
 local action
 local file
 local command
 local result
 while test "$#" -gt 0; do
  number=$((number + 1))
  action=$1
  file=$2
  shift 2
  case "$file" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) return 2 ;; esac
  if test "$file" = "$destination"; then return 2; fi
  if test -f "$file"; then :; else return 2; fi
  case "$action" in
   ordered) result=$(sort -- "$file") ;;
   neighbors) result=$(uniq -- "$file") ;;
   owners) result=$(cut -s -d ':' -f 3 -- "$file") ;;
   *) return 2 ;;
  esac
  status=$?
  if test "$status" -ne 0; then return 2; fi
  printf 'Job %s: %s\nResult: <%s>\n' "$number" "$action" "$result"
 done
}
if plan=$(prepare "$@"); then :; else invalid; exit 2; fi
if test "$mode" = preview; then
 printf 'Preview\n%s\n' "$plan"
else
 printf '%s\n' "$plan" > "$destination"
 printf 'Published %s jobs to %s\n' "$((count / 2))" "$destination"
fi

  case "$2" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) return 2 ;; esac
  if test "$2" = "$destination"; then return 2; fi

  shift 2
 done
}

 case "$1" in

 esac
}
if validate "$@"; then :; else invalid; exit 2; fi

  printf 'Job %s: %s\nResult: <%s>\n' "$number" "$1" "$result"
 else

 fi
 shift 2

case "$mode" in preview|apply) : ;; *) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$destination" in ''|-|.|..|*/*|keep.txt) invalid; exit 2 ;; esac
LC_ALL=C
prepare() {
 local number=0
 local action
 local file
 local command
 local result
 while test "$#" -gt 0; do
  number=$((number + 1))
  action=$1
  file=$2
  shift 2
  case "$file" in ''|-|.|..|*/*) return 2 ;; esac
  if test "$file" = "$destination"; then return 2; fi
  if test -f "$file"; then :; else return 2; fi
  command=()
  case "$action" in
   ordered) command=(sort) ;;
   neighbors) command=(uniq) ;;
   owners) command=(cut -s -d ':' -f 3) ;;
   *) return 2 ;;
  esac
  command=("${command[@]}" -- "$file")
  if result=$("${command[@]}"); then :; else return 2; fi
  printf 'Job %s: %s\nResult: <%s>\n' "$number" "$action" "$result"
 done
}
if plan=$(prepare "$@"); then :; else invalid; exit 2; fi
if test "$mode" = preview; then
 printf 'Preview\n%s\n' "$plan"
else
 printf '%s\n' "$plan" > "$destination"
 printf 'Published %s jobs to %s\n' "$((count / 2))" "$destination"
fi
